dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: No new safeguards decision, verified weapons-grade production, weaponization order, detonation or NPT withdrawal appeared. AP says the nuclear issue remains set aside while intermediaries try to preserve talks; IAEA public news and press pages again returned HTTP 403. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reports three strike-free days and quotes regional officials describing significant mediation progress toward returning Washington and Tehran to an interim arrangement. Iran says intermediaries are carrying messages and Iran-Oman work is focused on a vessel-transit mechanism, but there are no direct U.S.-Iran negotiations, the Strait remains closed, the U.S. blockade remains in force and traffic is at a three-week low. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP says U.S.-supported Lebanon-Israel talks continue, while one Iranian outlet reported activity near Nabatieh without independently verified casualties or a strategic change. No new withdrawal timetable, mass-casualty event or distinct Hezbollah escalation was verified. Raw 87; coupled 97

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: A single analytical outlet reported renewal of Turkey’s Somalia mandate, including protection of planned space and missile facilities. This is a mandate renewal rather than verified new combat entry or unusual force concentration, and no new Turkish range or nuclear-doctrine threshold appeared. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No post-09Z Line of Control fire, unusual force concentration, interstate strike or operational order was reported. A Rawalakot casualty result was dated 14 July and concerns internal Pakistan-administered Kashmir unrest, not a fresh India-Pakistan clash. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh state-on-state strike, sustained border clash, crossing closure or unusual force movement was corroborated after 09Z. Current resistance claims inside Afghanistan and older Pakistan militant violence do not establish a new interstate threshold. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP reporting says Russian attacks killed two people in Ukraine and Ukrainian drones killed four in Russian-held territory. The casualty update reinforces the active high-intensity war but does not add direct NATO combat or a nuclear-posture shift. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-09Z indexing added commentary rather than a new PLA operation. The latest operational count remains seven PLAN vessels and four Chinese official ships; no blockade, amphibious concentration, live-fire expansion or direct clash was verified. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: South Korea says it is monitoring reports that Russia could receive 30,000 more North Korean troops, while the Kremlin rejected Zelensky’s account. Multiple fresh headlines remain downstream of the same allegation; no verified deployment, launch or nuclear detonation appeared. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Saudi Gazette and Türkiye Today repeated the Sudanese army’s claimed recapture of the Khartoum–el-Obeid route. Raw 94; coupled 94

dashboard_trackers.notes: Current reporting continues to describe the already-counted West Bank mosque arson, raids and Gaza casualties.
